data: Apple was the larger company by revenue in fiscal 2024, reporting net sales of $391,035 million (about $391.0 billion) for the year ended September 28, 2024, versus Microsoft's revenue of $245,122 million (about $245.1 billion) for the year ended June 30, 2024. That makes Apple roughly 1.6 times as large as Microsoft ($391,035 / $245,122 ≈ 1.60), a gap of about $145.9 billion. The fiscal years end on different dates, so the comparison is not over identical twelve-month periods. Apple's revenue grew about 2.0% from $383,285 million in fiscal 2023, while Microsoft's grew about 15.7% from $211,915 million.
